source: Adapted from Jakeschincariol/instagram-agent-skill skills/ig-profile/rubric.json (MIT, commit d03c56bb): the twelve items and their weights; wording rewritten for a hospitality business. See docs/marketing-website/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

items.label: Name field
items.full_marks: The bold Name line (30 characters, not the handle) carries your brand plus what you are and where, in words guests search: 'Nila Stays | Pool villas, Coonoor'. Instagram search reads this field.
items.fix: Put what you are and where next to your brand in the Name field, e.g. 'Nila Stays | Pool villas, Coonoor'.

items.label: Bio first line
items.full_marks: Line one says who the stay is for and what they get, in guests' words. Not a list of adjectives or three emoji between bars.
items.fix: Start the bio with who the stay is for and what they get, as a sentence, not a list.

items.label: Bio proof or offer
items.full_marks: The rest of the 150 characters carries one piece of proof (a rating, a detail only you have) or one plain way to book, as sentences.
items.fix: Use the rest of the bio for one proof point or how to book (e.g. 'DM us for dates'), written as a sentence.

items.label: Pinned posts
items.full_marks: Three posts pinned, each doing a different job: the place at its best, a guest review, how to book.
items.fix: Pin three posts: the place at its best, a guest review, and how to book.

items.label: Link
items.full_marks: One link that goes where the bio promises (your website or booking page). Two or more is a menu, and a menu books worse than a door.
items.fix: Add one link to your website or booking page in Edit profile > Links.

items.label: Highlights
items.full_marks: Four to six highlights named for what guests ask: Stays, Reviews, How to book, Location. Covers consistent, nothing stale at the front.
items.fix: Keep four to six highlights named for guests' questions (Stays, Reviews, How to book, Location).

items.label: First nine posts
items.full_marks: The first nine covers say what the place is at thumbnail size, without a tap. Reel covers chosen, not left on frame one.
items.fix: Pick reel covers on purpose and make the first nine posts show the place clearly at thumbnail size.

items.label: Profile photo
items.full_marks: A logo or one clear image that reads in a 40-pixel circle, with nothing competing in the background.
items.fix: Use a logo or one simple image that still reads when it is tiny.

items.label: Handle
items.full_marks: Readable and sayable, the same as on your other channels. No stacked underscores or numbers standing in for letters.
items.fix: Use a handle people can spell after hearing it once, the same as on your other channels.

items.label: Category and contact
items.full_marks: A professional account with a category that fits the stay, and contact buttons that work (WhatsApp or call).
items.fix: Pick a category that fits the stay and add a WhatsApp or call button.

items.label: Recent posts
items.full_marks: Posted in the last seven days and replied to the comments on the latest post. An account that last posted months ago reads as closed.
items.fix: Post at least once a week and reply to comments on your latest post.

items.label: Stories
items.full_marks: A story up on most days. It is the difference between a profile and a place that is open.
items.fix: Share a story most days: the morning view, the breakfast, the room being made up.
